verses.zh: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。
verses.en: (5:27)[NOTE:1] The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
notes: Beginning with 6:1, the verse numbers through 6:81 in the English Bible differ from the verse numbers in the Hebrew text (BHS), with 6:1 ET = 5:27 HT, 6:2 ET = 5:28 HT, 6:16 ET = 6:1 HT, etc., through 6:81 ET = 6:66 HT. Beginning with 7:1 the verse numbers in the ET and HT are again the same.
verses.commentary:
6:1 (MT 5:27) "The sons of Levi. . ." They are given specific tasks related to carrying the portable tent of meeting.

- Kohathites ‒ Num. 4:4-15

- Gershonites ‒ Num. 4:21-28

- Merarites ‒ Num. 4:29-33

The development of the concept and lineage of "levite" is spelled out clearly in G. B. Caird's, The
Language and Imagery of the Bible, pp. 68-72. He introduces the summary by this interesting quote, "The
history of the OT priesthood is a complex story in which many influences, social, ideological, and
technological, combined to produce semantic change. It is not possible to document the whole process
precisely, because many of the older sources were rewritten by later editors with a theological axe to grind"
(pp. 69-70).

▣ "Gershon" In Exod. 2:22 and Jdgs. 18:30 it is spelled "Gershom" (cf. 1 Chr. 6:17,20,43,62,71), from
the Hebrew "ger sham" (i.e., "a stranger there"). It is spelled with the final "m" in 1 Chr. 6:16. This shows that the Chronicler
is using separate genealogical lists.

verses.zh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。
verses.en: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.zh: 暗兰的儿子是亚伦、摩西，还有女儿米利暗。亚伦的儿子是拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
verses.en: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.zh: 以利亚撒生非尼哈；非尼哈生亚比书；
verses.en: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, and Phinehas was the father of Abishua.
verses.commentary:
6:4 (MT 5:30) "Eleazar" This is the son of Aaron who became the future High Priest. This line is developed until
the Babylonian exile of 586 B.C. (cf. 1 Chr. 6:15). Yet notice it is a selective, not exhaustive, list.

verses.zh: 亚比书生布基；布基生乌西；
verses.en: Abishua was the father of Bukki, and Bukki was the father of Uzzi.

verses.zh: 乌西生西拉希雅；西拉希雅生米拉约；
verses.en: Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah, and Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth.

verses.zh: 米拉约生亚玛利雅；亚玛利雅生亚希突；
verses.en: Meraioth was the father of Amariah, and Amariah was the father of Ahitub.

verses.zh: 亚希突生撒督；撒督生亚希玛斯；
verses.en: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, and Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz.
verses.commentary:
6:8 (MT 5:38) "Ahitub" This is not the "Ahitub" of the line of Eli (cf. 1 Sam. 14:3) at Shiloh, who later became a part
of Abiathar's line (cf. 1 Sam. 22:20).

verses.zh: 亚希玛斯生亚撒利雅；亚撒利雅生约哈难；
verses.en: Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah, and Azariah was the father of Johanan.
verses.commentary:
6:9-10 "Azariah" This name appears in 1 Chr. 6:9 and 10 and refers to different priests, both connected to
Solomon's temple (cf. 1 Kgs. 4:2 and the one in 6:9 and the one in 6:10 is a grandson of Zadok). Young's Analytical
Concordance lists 28 people by this name. It lists

- 1 Kgs. 4:2 as one priest

- 1 Chr. 6:9 as another

- 1 Chr. 6:10,11 as still another

- 1 Chr. 6:13,14; 9:11 as still another priest

Obviously names run through families, genealogies are not complete, and there is confusion!

verses.zh: 约哈难生亚撒利雅（这亚撒利雅在所罗门于耶路撒冷所建造的殿中，供祭司的职分）；
verses.en: Johanan was the father of Azariah, who served as a priest in the temple Solomon built in Jerusalem.[NOTE:1]
notes: For location see Map5-B1; Map6-F3; Map7-E2; Map8-F2; Map10-B3; JP1-F4; JP2-F4; JP3-F4; JP4-F4.
verses.commentary:
6:10 "the house which Solomon built in Jerusalem" The word "house" (BDB 108), in this context, means
"temple" (cf. 2 Kgs. 11:10,11,13; 2 Chr. 23:10; 35:20).

In the key theological text of YHWH's special covenant with David, there is a word play on house (i.e.,
2 Samuel 7; 1 Chronicles 17).

- David wants to build YHWH a house/temple.

- But YHWH will build David a "house," meaning dynasty.

verses.zh: 亚撒利雅生亚玛利雅；亚玛利雅生亚希突；
verses.en: Azariah was the father of Amariah, and Amariah was the father of Ahitub.

verses.zh: 亚希突生撒督；撒督生沙龙；
verses.en: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, and Zadok was the father of Shallum.
verses.commentary:
6:12 (MT 5:38) "Zadok" This High Priest served along with Abiathar during David's reign and later Solomon's
(cf. 2 Sam. 8:17; 1 Kings 1). He supported the reign of Solomon and was made the only functioning High Priest under
Solomon.

verses.zh: 沙龙生希勒家；希勒家生亚撒利雅；
verses.en: Shallum was the father of Hilkiah, and Hilkiah was the father of Azariah.
verses.commentary:
6:13 (MT 5:39) "Hilkiah" This is the High Priest who found the "book of the law" during the remodeling of the
temple in Joshua's day (cf. 2 Kings 22; 2 Chronicles 34).

verses.zh: 亚撒利雅生西莱雅；西莱雅生约萨答。
verses.en: Azariah was the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak.
verses.commentary:
6:14 (MT 5:40) The line of the High Priest proceeded to "Seraiah," who was killed by Nebuchadnezzar II
(cf. 2 Kgs. 25:18-21).

▣ "Jehozadak" This was the high priestly line exiled to Babylon. He is called "Jozadak" in Ezra and
Nehemiah. His son, "Jeshua" or "Joshua," will partner with Zerubbabel, the prince of the line of David, to form the
leadership of the post-exilic faith community in the restored Judah (see Ezra, Nehemiah, Haggai, and Zechariah).

SPECIAL TOPIC: TIMELINE OF THE POST-EXILIC PERIOD

verses.zh: 当耶和华藉尼布甲尼撒的手掳掠犹大和耶路撒冷人的时候，这约萨答也被掳去。
verses.en: Jehozadak went into exile when the Lord sent the people of[NOTE:1] Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
notes: The words “the people of” are added in the translation for clarification.
verses.commentary:
6:15 (MT 5:41) "when the Lord carried Judah and Jerusalem away into exile"" The
centrality of "Judah" and "Jerusalem" (i.e., the temple) shows the seriousness of this divine act of judgment (cf. 1 Chr. 5:26;
Jer. 29:4,7,14; Lam. 4:22; Ezek. 39:28; Amos 5:27).

The God who gave Israel the land (cf. Gen. 15:12-21) now takes it away. When Israel acts like
Canaanites, they suffer the same judgment.

verses.zh: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。
verses.en: (6:1)[NOTE:1] The sons of Levi: Gershom,[NOTE:2] Kohath, and Merari.
notes: Chapter 6 of 1 Chr begins here in the Hebrew text; 6:16-81 ET = 6:1-66 HT. See the note at 6:1.
The name “Gershom” (also in vv. 17, 20, 43, 62, 71) appears as “Gershon” in 1 Chr 6:1.
verses.commentary:
6:16-19 These are the three sons of Levi mentioned in Gen. 46:11; Exod. 6:16-19; Num. 3:17-20; 26:57-58.
The repetition shows their significance.

verses.zh: 革顺的儿子名叫立尼、示每。
verses.en: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

verses.zh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。
verses.en: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利、母示。这是按着利未人宗族分的各家。
verses.en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi.These are the clans of the Levites by their families.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “by their fathers.”

verses.zh: 革顺的儿子是立尼；立尼的儿子是雅哈；雅哈的儿子是薪玛；
verses.en: To Gershom: his son Libni, his son Jahath, his son Zimmah,

verses.zh: 薪玛的儿子是约亚；约亚的儿子是易多；易多的儿子是谢拉；谢拉的儿子是耶特赖。
verses.en: his son Joah, his son Iddo, his son Zerah, and his son Jeatherai.

verses.zh: 哥辖的儿子是亚米拿达；亚米拿达的儿子是可拉；可拉的儿子是亚惜；
verses.en: The sons[NOTE:1] of Kohath: his son Amminadab, his son Korah, his son Assir,
notes: Or perhaps, “descendants,” since the list differs from the one in v. 18.
verses.commentary:
6:22 (MT 6:7) "sons" Since this differs from 1 Chr. 6:18, it may refer to descendants, not literally sons.

▣ "Korah" In 1 Chr. 6:22 "Korah," the Levite who rebelled and was swallowed by the earth (cf. Numbers
16), is said to be the son (Kohath) Amminadab, but in 1 Chr. 6:38 the same genealogy of Num. 16:1 appears "the son of
Izhah, the son of Kohath." They may be

- two names for the same person

- the genealogies

- a different Korah

verses.zh: 亚惜的儿子是以利加拿；以利加拿的儿子是以比雅撒；以比雅撒的儿子是亚惜；
verses.en: his son Elkanah, his son Ebiasaph, his son Assir,

verses.zh: 亚惜的儿子是他哈；他哈的儿子是乌列；乌列的儿子是乌西雅；乌西雅的儿子是少罗。
verses.en: his son Tahath, his son Uriel, his son Uzziah, and his son Shaul.
verses.commentary: 6:24 "Uriel" In 1 Chr. 15:5 there is a "Urial" who is a descendant of Kohath. These may be the same person.

verses.zh: 以利加拿的儿子是亚玛赛和亚希摩。
verses.en: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai, Ahimoth,[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “and Achimoth.”
verses.commentary:
6:25 "Elkanah" This is not the same Elkanah as 1 Chr. 6:35-36, but a later relative of Ebiasaph, Elkanah of
1 Chr. 6:25's brother.

verses.zh: 亚希摩的儿子是以利加拿；以利加拿的儿子是琐菲；琐菲的儿子是拿哈；
verses.en: his son Elkanah,[NOTE:1] his son Zophai, his son Nahath,
notes: The consonantal Hebrew text (Kethib) has, “Elkanah, his son, Elkanah.” The marginal reading (Qere) is “Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah.” The text probably originally read simply, “Elkanah his son.”

verses.zh: 拿哈的儿子是以利押；以利押的儿子是耶罗罕；耶罗罕的儿子是以利加拿；以利加拿的儿子是撒母耳。
verses.en: his son Eliab, his son Jeroham, and his son Elkanah.[NOTE:1]
notes: After the last named individual (“Elkanah” in v. 27) some LXX mss insert the words “Samuel his son” to facilitate a transition to the following verse, which begins “and the sons of Samuel.” Among the English versions that include this added phrase are NAB, NIV, and NLT.
verses.commentary:
6:27 Are the descendants of Elkanah listed in 1 Chr. 6:26,27 the same as the descendants of Elkanah of
1 Chr. 6:34-35? It is very hard to coordinate these lists because of

- the semantic field of "son"

- the partial nature of the lists themselves

- the merging of several lists

- the limited historical information of this period

verses.zh: 撒母耳的长子是约珥，次子是亚比亚。
verses.en: The sons of Samuel: Joel the firstborn[NOTE:1] and Abijah the second oldest.
notes: The Hebrew text lacks the name יוֹאֵל (yoʾel, “Joel”), which has probably dropped out due to homoioteleuton (note the last three letters of the preceding name שְׁמוּאֵל (shemuel, “Samuel”).
verses.commentary:
6:28 (MT 6:13) "Samuel" This is the descendant of Levi who plays such a prominent role in 1 Samuel.
He was priest, prophet, and judge. Apparently he was from the area of Ephraim (cf. 1 Sam. 1:1).

▣ "Joel" This name is not included here in the MT but it is found in 1 Chr. 6:33 and 1 Sam. 8:2.

▣ "the second" Since the name "Joel" fell out of the MT, later translators (i.e., the Masoretic scholars)
made the numerical reference a name "Vashni."

verses.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利；抹利的儿子是立尼；立尼的儿子是示每；示每的儿子是乌撒；
verses.en: The descendants of Merari: Mahli, his son Libni, his son Shimei, his son Uzzah,

verses.zh: 乌撒的儿子是示米亚；示米亚的儿子是哈基雅；哈基雅的儿子是亚帅雅。
verses.en: his son Shimea, his son Haggiah, and his son Asaiah.

verses.zh: 约柜安设之后，大卫派人在耶和华殿中管理歌唱的事。
verses.en: These are the men David put in charge of music in the Lord’s sanctuary,[NOTE:1] after the ark was placed there.
notes: Heb “house.”
verses.commentary:
6:31 (MT 6:16) "whom David appointed" This is recorded in 1 Chr. 15:16-22,27; 16:4-6.

▣ "the service of song in the house of the Lord" Literally the phrase starts out
"at the hands of song." The word "song" can refer to

- a song

- a choir (cf. 1 Chr. 23:18; 29:28; Neh. 12:31)

- music of worship

- instruments which accompany worship music (cf. 2 Sam. 6:5; 1 Chr. 15:16; 25:6-7; Neh. 12:27; Amos 6:5)

Obviously the phrase refers to all aspects of music in worship. These Levitical families wrote, sang, played,
trained, and organized the music of worship. It appears that music was part of the tabernacle worship as well as the temple
of Solomon.

▣ "the ark" See
SPECIAL TOPIC: ARK OF THE COVENANT.

verses.zh: 他们就在会幕前当歌唱的差，及至所罗门在耶路撒冷建造了耶和华的殿，他们便按着班次供职。
verses.en: They performed music[NOTE:1] before the sanctuary[NOTE:2] of the meeting tent until Solomon built the Lord’s temple in Jerusalem.[NOTE:3] They carried out their tasks according to regulations.
notes: Heb “they were serving…with music.”
Or traditionally “tabernacle.”
For location see Map5-B1; Map6-F3; Map7-E2; Map8-F2; Map10-B3; JP1-F4; JP2-F4; JP3-F4; JP4-F4.
verses.commentary:
6:32 (MT 6:17) "the tabernacle of the tent of meeting. . .the house of the Lord in
Jerusalem" The first authorized revelation/worship site was the portable tent of the exodus and wilderness wandering
period (cf. Exodus 25-40). In 2 Samuel 7 David desired to build a "house/temple" for YHWH. YHWH would not let him
because he was a man of war, but allowed his son, Solomon (cf. 1 Kings 6-7; see the wonderful dedication prayer in
1 Kings 8) to build it.

SPECIAL TOPIC: TABERNACLE

▣ "they served in their office according to their order" This is outlined in 1 Chr. 24:1-19; 28:13. These
divisions were designed and implemented by David. Whether there was earlier division is uncertain.

verses.zh: 供职的人和他们的子孙记在下面：哥辖的子孙中有歌唱的希幔。希幔是约珥的儿子；约珥是撒母耳的儿子；
verses.en: These are the ones who served along with their sons:From the Kohathites: Heman the musician, son of Joel, son of Samuel,
verses.commentary:
6:33-47 There are three main singers from each of Levi's sons (1 Chr. 6:1; 15:17,19).

- Gershon, Gershom ‒ Asaph (1 Chr. 6:39-43)

- Kohath ‒ Heman (1 Chr. 6:33-38)

- Merari ‒ Ethan (1 Chr. 6:44-47)

There is an Ethan mentioned in 1 Chr. 6:42 who is of the line of Gershon and another by the same name in

verses.zh: 撒母耳是以利加拿的儿子；以利加拿是耶罗罕的儿子；耶罗罕是以列的儿子；以列是陀亚的儿子；
verses.en: son of Elkanah, son of Jeroham, son of Eliel, son of Toah,

verses.zh: 陀亚是苏弗的儿子；苏弗是以利加拿的儿子；以利加拿是玛哈的儿子；玛哈是亚玛赛的儿子；
verses.en: son of Zuph, son of Elkanah, son of Mahath, son of Amasai,

verses.zh: 亚玛赛是以利加拿的儿子；以利加拿是约珥的儿子；约珥是亚撒利雅的儿子；亚撒利雅是西番雅的儿子；
verses.en: son of Elkanah, son of Joel, son of Azariah, son of Zephaniah,

verses.zh: 西番雅是他哈的儿子；他哈是亚惜的儿子；亚惜是以比雅撒的儿子；以比雅撒是可拉的儿子；
verses.en: son of Tahath, son of Assir, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah,

verses.zh: 可拉是以斯哈的儿子；以斯哈是哥辖的儿子；哥辖是利未的儿子；利未是以色列的儿子。
verses.en: son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, son of Israel.
verses.commentary:
6:38 (MT 6:23) "Israel" This name is used three times in this chapter.

- here ‒ to refer to Jacob

- 1 Chr. 6:49 ‒ to refer to the collective nation

- 1 Chr. 6:64 ‒ to the descendants of Israel during Joshua's time

SPECIAL TOPIC: ISRAEL (THE NAME)

verses.zh: 希幔的族兄亚萨是比利家的儿子，亚萨在希幔右边供职。比利家是示米亚的儿子；
verses.en: Serving beside him was his fellow Levite Asaph,[NOTE:1] son of Berechiah, son of Shimea,
notes: Heb “and his brother Asaph, the one who stood at his right hand.”
verses.commentary:
6:39 (MT 6:24) "stood at his right hand" Notice 1 Chr. 6:44 has "on the left hand." This is detailed eyewitness
testimony of the staging of the Levite musicians.

verses.zh: 示米亚是米迦勒的儿子；米迦勒是巴西雅的儿子；巴西雅是玛基雅的儿子；
verses.en: son of Michael, son of Baaseiah,[NOTE:1] son of Malkijah,
notes: A few Hebrew mss, one LXX ms, and the Syriac read “Maaseiah.”
verses.commentary: 6:40 (MT 6:24) "Baaseiah" The LXX and early Syriac have "Maaseiah" and the Peshitta has "Measiah."

verses.zh: 玛基雅是伊特尼的儿子；伊特尼是谢拉的儿子；谢拉是亚大雅的儿子；
verses.en: son of Ethni, son of Zerah, son of Adaiah,

verses.zh: 亚大雅是以探的儿子；以探是薪玛的儿子；薪玛是示每的儿子；
verses.en: son of Ethan, son of Zimmah, son of Shimei,

verses.zh: 示每是雅哈的儿子；雅哈是革顺的儿子。革顺是利未的儿子。
verses.en: son of Jahath, son of Gershom, son of Levi.

verses.zh: 他们的族弟兄米拉利的子孙，在他们左边供职的有以探。以探是基示的儿子；基示是亚伯底的儿子；亚伯底是玛鹿的儿子；
verses.en: Serving beside them were their fellow Levites, the descendants of Merari, led by[NOTE:1] Ethan, son of Kishi, son of Abdi, son of Malluch,
notes: Heb “and the sons of Merari, their brothers, on the left.”
verses.commentary: 6:44 of the line of Merari.

verses.zh: 玛鹿是哈沙比雅的儿子；哈沙比雅是亚玛谢的儿子；亚玛谢是希勒家的儿子；
verses.en: son of Hashabiah, son of Amaziah, son of Hilkiah,

verses.zh: 希勒家是暗西的儿子；暗西是巴尼的儿子；巴尼是沙麦的儿子；
verses.en: son of Amzi, son of Bani, son of Shemer,

verses.zh: 沙麦是末力的儿子；末力是母示的儿子；母示是米拉利的儿子；米拉利是利未的儿子。
verses.en: son of Mahli, son of Mushi, son of Merari, son of Levi.

verses.zh: 他们的族弟兄利未人也被派办　神殿中的一切事。
verses.en: The rest of their fellow Levites[NOTE:1] were assigned to perform the remaining tasks at God’s sanctuary.[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “their brothers, the Levites.”
Heb “were assigned to all the work of the tabernacle of the house of God.”
verses.commentary:
6:48 (MT 6:32) This may refer to the Nethinim (BDB 682) of Jos. 9:27, cf. 1 Chr. 9:2; Ezra 2:43,70; 7:7,24;
8:20; Neh. 7:46-56.

However, it probably clarifies the menial tasks of the Levites versus the priests (1 Chr. 6:49). There
was an institutional gradation in the family of Levi.

verses.zh: 亚伦和他的子孙在燔祭坛和香坛上献祭烧香，又在至圣所办理一切的事，为以色列人赎罪，是照　神仆人摩西所吩咐的。
verses.en: But Aaron and his descendants offered sacrifices on the altar for burnt offerings and on the altar for incense as they had been assigned to do in the Most Holy Sanctuary.[NOTE:1] They made atonement for Israel, just as God’s servant Moses had ordered.[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “for all the work of the holy of holies.”
Heb “making atonement for Israel according to all which Moses the servant of God commanded.”
verses.commentary:
6:49 (MT 6:33)

NASB, NKJV, NRSV, Peshitta
"offered"

TEV
"presented"

NJB
"burned"

LXX
"burning incense"

REB
"burnt"

This VERB (BDB 882, KB 1094, Hiphil ACTIVE PARTICIPLE) can mean

- make sacrifices smoke (i.e., place on the altar, cf. 1 Kgs. 12:33; 2 Chr. 29:1; both of which could fit #2)

- cause incense (1 Chr. 23:13; 2 Chr. 2:4; 26:18,19)

Here, as in several of the above references, it could refer to sacrifices on the altar of sacrifice or incense
on the altar of incense.

1 Chronicles 6:49 gives a summary statement of the duties of the priests according to the Mosaic Covenant.

However, here sacrifice has priority but in Deut. 33:8-11, there are two other responsibilities mentioned.

- care of the oracle (i.e., Urim and Thummim)

- legal decisions

SPECIAL TOPIC: ALTAR OF SACRIFICE

SPECIAL TOPIC: ALTAR OF INCENSE

SPECIAL TOPIC: URIM AND THUMMIM

▣ "the most holy place" The central tent of the tabernacle was a rectangle divided into two-thirds of an
outer court (i.e., the holy place, cf. Exod. 26:33) and a perfect cube at the far end called the "most holy place" or "Holy
of Holies" (cf. Exod. 26:33-34), where only the High Priest could enter on the Day of Atonement (Leviticus 16).

verses.zh: 亚伦的儿子是以利亚撒；以利亚撒的儿子是非尼哈；非尼哈的儿子是亚比书；
verses.en: These were the descendants of Aaron:His son Eleazar, his son Phinehas, his son Abishua,
verses.commentary: 6:50-53 This is a repeat of 1 Chr. 6:3-8. This shows that several genealogical lists are being merged in this chapter.

verses.zh: 亚比书的儿子是布基；布基的儿子是乌西；乌西的儿子是西拉希雅；
verses.en: his son Bukki, his son Uzzi, his son Zerahiah,

verses.zh: 西拉希雅的儿子是米拉约；米拉约的儿子是亚玛利雅；亚玛利雅的儿子是亚希突；
verses.en: his son Meraioth, his son Amariah, his son Ahitub,

verses.zh: 亚希突的儿子是撒督；撒督的儿子是亚希玛斯。
verses.en: his son Zadok, and his son Ahimaaz.

verses.zh: 他们的住处按着境内的营寨，记在下面：哥辖族亚伦的子孙先拈阄得地，
verses.en: These were the areas where Aaron’s descendants lived:[NOTE:1] The following belonged to the Kohathite clan, for they received the first allotment:[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “and these were their dwelling places according to their encampments in their territory to the sons of Aaron.”
Heb “to the clan of the Kohathites for to them was the lot.”
verses.commentary:
6:54 (MT 6:39) "the first lot" This refers to Joshua's use of the Urim and Thummim (cf. Jos. 21:4,10).
The lot was Israel's way to know the will of God. These cities were not given by human reasoning but by God's choice and mercy.

The tribe of Aaron did not receive a land allocation but they did receive houses and small pieces of land
for gardening around 48 geographically scattered cities (cf. 1 Chr. 6:57). The tribe of Levi was purposely spread throughout
Israel. The Levites were not the only, or even majority, inhabitants of these 48 cities. This is clear from 1 Chr. 6:55-56 (i.e.,
Hebron, both a city of Levites and the inheritance of Caleb by Moses, cf. Jos. 14:6-15).

verses.zh: 在犹大地中得了希伯仑和四围的郊野；
verses.en: They were allotted Hebron in the territory of Judah, as well as its surrounding pasturelands.
verses.commentary:
6:55 "Hebron" This is an important location for the Patriarchs in southern Canaan. It was first called Kiriath Arba,
Gen. 23:2; Jos. 14:15; Jdgs. 1:10.

- Abraham built an altar there, Gen. 13:18

- Abraham purchased a burial cave, Genesis 23

- close to the "oaks of Mamre," Gen. 13:18; 18:1; 23:19; 35:27

- it was given as part of Judah's land allocation, Jos. 15:54

- it was given to Caleb as a special reward by Moses, Jos. 14:13-15; 15:13; Jdgs. 1:20

- it was a Levitical city, Jos. 21:11,13; 1 Chr. 6:55

- it was a city of refuge, Jos. 20:7; 1 Chr. 6:57

verses.zh: 只是属城的田地和村庄都为耶孚尼的儿子迦勒所得。
verses.en: (But the city’s land and nearby towns were allotted to Caleb son of Jephunneh.)

verses.zh: 亚伦的子孙得了逃城希伯仑，又得了立拿与其郊野，雅提珥、以实提莫与其郊野；
verses.en: The descendants of Aaron were also allotted as cities[NOTE:1] of refuge Hebron, Libnah and its pasturelands, Jattir, Eshtemoa and its pasturelands,
notes: The parallel account in Josh 21:13 has the singular “city,” which apparently refers only to Hebron.
verses.commentary:
6:57 "cities of refuge" These are specialized Levitical cities. They become places for man-slayers to seek
refuge and justice from kinsmen avengers (cf. Numbers 35; Deut. 19:1-10; Joshua 20).

SPECIAL TOPIC: CITIES OF REFUGE

verses.zh: 希仑与其郊野，底璧与其郊野，
verses.en: Hilez[NOTE:1] and its pasturelands, Debir and its pasturelands,
notes: The MT reads “Hilez” here; the place name appears as “Holon” in Josh 21:15.
verses.commentary:
6:58 (MT 6:43) "Hilen" In Jos. 21:15 it is called "Holon." The UBS Text Project suggests "Hilen" and gives it a "C" rating
(considerable doubt). The MT has "Hilez."

verses.zh: 亚珊与其郊野，伯・示麦与其郊野。
verses.en: Ashan[NOTE:1] and its pasturelands,[NOTE:2] and Beth Shemesh and its pasturelands.
notes: The MT reads “Ashan” here; the place name appears as “Ain” in Josh 21:16.
The LXX and Syriac (following the parallel list in Josh 21:16) add “Juttah and its pasturelands” here. Cf. NAB “Jetta”; also NIV, NCV, NLT “Juttah.”
verses.commentary:
6:59 (MT 6:44) "Ashan" In Jos. 21:16 it is called "Ain."

Also in Jos. 21:16 an added city is named "Juttah with its pasture lands." This same kind of addition
occurs in 1 Chr. 6:60 (cf. Jos. 21:17).

verses.zh: 在便雅悯支派的地中，得了迦巴与其郊野，阿勒篾与其郊野，亚拿突与其郊野。他们诸家所得的城共十三座。
verses.en: Within the territory of the tribe of Benjamin, they were allotted[NOTE:1] Geba and its pasturelands, Alemeth and its pasturelands, and Anathoth and its pasturelands. Their clans were allotted thirteen cities in all.
notes: The parallel passage in Josh 21:17 adds “Gibeon and its pasturelands” (cf. NAB, NIV, NCV, NLT). The words “they were allotted” are supplied in the translation for both clarity and stylistic reasons.

verses.zh: 哥辖族其余的人又拈阄，在玛拿西半支派的地中得了十座城。
verses.en: The rest of Kohath’s descendants were allotted ten cities in the territory of the half-tribe of Manasseh.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “to the sons of Kohath who were left from the clan of the tribe, from the half of the tribe of the half of Manasseh by lot ten cities.”
verses.commentary:
6:61 (MT 6:46) This verse states that the family of Kohalath received ten cities from the half-tribe of
Manasseh. Joshua 21:5 says these cities were from Ephraim, Manasseh, and Dan. The land from Ephraim
is dealt with in 1 Chr. 6:66-70. Dan is not mentioned at all.

verses.zh: 革顺族按着宗族，在以萨迦支派的地中，亚设支派的地中，拿弗他利支派的地中，巴珊内玛拿西支派的地中，得了十三座城。
verses.en: The clans of Gershom’s descendants received thirteen cities within the territory of the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh (in Bashan).[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “and to the sons of Gershom by their clans from the tribe of Issachar, and from the tribe of Asher, and from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.”

verses.zh: 米拉利族按着宗族拈阄，在流便支派的地中，迦得支派的地中，西布伦支派的地中，得了十二座城。
verses.en: The clans of Merari’s descendants were allotted twelve cities within the territory of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “and to the sons of Merari by their clans from the tribe of Reuben, and from the tribe of Gad, and from the tribe of Zebulun by lot, twelve cities.”

verses.zh: 以色列人将这些城与其郊野给了利未人。
verses.en: So the Israelites gave to the Levites these cities and their pasturelands.

verses.zh: 这以上录名的城，在犹大、西缅、便雅悯三支派的地中，以色列人拈阄给了他们。
verses.en: They allotted these previously named cities from the territory of the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “and they gave by lot from the tribe of the sons of Judah, and from the tribe of the sons of Simeon, and from the tribe of the sons of Benjamin these cities, which they called them by names.”

verses.zh: 哥辖族中有几家在以法莲支派的地中也得了城邑，
verses.en: The clans of Kohath’s descendants also received cities as their territory within the tribe of Ephraim.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “and from [it is probably preferable to read “to” here] the clans of the sons of Kohath and there were the cities of their territory from the tribe of Ephraim.”

verses.zh: 在以法莲山地得了逃城示剑与其郊野，又得了基色与其郊野，
verses.en: They were allotted as cities[NOTE:1] of refuge Shechem and its pasturelands (in the hill country of Ephraim), Gezer and its pasturelands,
notes: The parallel account in Josh 21:21 has the singular “city,” referring only to Shechem.

verses.zh: 约缅与其郊野，伯・和仑与其郊野，
verses.en: Jokmeam and its pasturelands, Beth Horon and its pasturelands,
verses.commentary: 6:68 "Jokmeam" In Joshua 21:22 he is named "Kibzaim."

verses.zh: 亚雅仑与其郊野，迦特・临门与其郊野。
verses.en: Aijalon and its pasturelands, and Gath Rimmon and its pasturelands.

verses.zh: 哥辖族其余的人在玛拿西半支派的地中得了亚乃与其郊野，比连与其郊野。
verses.en: Within the territory of the half-tribe of Manasseh, the rest of Kohath’s descendants received Aner and its pasturelands and Bileam and its pasturelands.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “and from the half of the tribe of Manasseh, Aner and its pasturelands and Bileam and its pasturelands to the clan, to the sons of Kohath who were left.”
verses.commentary:
6:70 (MT 6:55) "Bileam" The LXX and Targums have "Ieblaam" or "Ibleam." Apparently it was common
to drop the yod in proper names (cf. AB, pp. 17,43).

verses.zh: 革顺族在玛拿西半支派的地中得了巴珊的哥兰与其郊野，亚斯他录与其郊野；
verses.en: The following belonged to Gershom’s descendants:[NOTE:1] Within the territory of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and its pasturelands and Ashtaroth and its pasturelands.
notes: Heb “to the sons of Gershom.”

verses.zh: 又在以萨迦支派的地中得了基低斯与其郊野，大比拉与其郊野，
verses.en: Within the territory of the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh and its pasturelands, Daberath and its pasturelands,
verses.commentary: 6:72 (MT 6:57) "Kedesh" In Joshua 19:20; 21:28, it is called "Kishion."

verses.zh: 拉末与其郊野，亚年与其郊野；
verses.en: Ramoth and its pasturelands, and Anem and its pasturelands.
verses.commentary: 6:73 (MT 6:58) "Anem" In Joshua 19:21 it is called "En-gannim."

verses.zh: 在亚设支派的地中得了玛沙与其郊野，押顿与其郊野，
verses.en: Within the territory of the tribe of Asher: Mashal and its pasturelands, Abdon and its pasturelands,

verses.zh: 户割与其郊野，利合与其郊野；
verses.en: Hukok and its pasturelands, and Rehob and its pasturelands.
verses.commentary: 6:75 "Hukok" In Joshua 19:25; 21:31 he is named "Helkath."

verses.zh: 在拿弗他利支派的地中得了加利利的基低斯与其郊野，哈们与其郊野，基列亭与其郊野。
verses.en: Within the territory of the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee and its pasturelands, Hammon and its pasturelands, and Kiriathaim and its pasturelands.

verses.zh: 还有米拉利族的人在西布伦支派的地中得了临摩挪与其郊野，他泊与其郊野；
verses.en: The following belonged to the rest of Merari’s descendants:[NOTE:1] Within the territory of the tribe of Zebulun: Rimmono[NOTE:2] and its pasturelands and Tabor and its pasturelands.
notes: Heb “to the sons of Merari, who were left.”

Before “Rimmono” the LXX (following the parallel passage in Josh 21:34) adds “Jokneam and its pasturelands, Kartah and its pasturelands.” This addition is included in some English versions (e.g., NAB, NIV, NCV, NLT).
verses.commentary:
6:77 (MT 6:62) "Rimmono" In Joshua 19:13 it is called "Rimmon." The UBS Text Project thinks the
original MT had "Rimmonah" ("B" rating, some doubt). This place is located close to Mt. Tabor (NE edge
of the Valley of Jezreel).

As we have seen several times, the parallel in Joshua (cf. Jos. 21:34) has additional places added.

verses.zh: 又在耶利哥的约旦河东，在流便支派的地中得了旷野的比悉与其郊野，雅哈撒与其郊野，
verses.en: Within the territory of the tribe of Reuben across the Jordan River east of Jericho:[NOTE:1] Bezer in the wilderness and its pasturelands, Jahzah and its pasturelands,
notes: Heb “and from across the Jordan at Jericho, on the east of the Jordan, from the tribe of Reuben.” The word “River” is supplied in the translation for clarity.map For location see Map5-B2; Map6-E1; Map7-E1; Map8-E3; Map10-A2; Map11-A1.

verses.zh: 基底莫与其郊野，米法押与其郊野；
verses.en: Kedemoth and its pasturelands, and Mephaath and its pasturelands.

verses.zh: 又在迦得支派的地中得了基列的拉末与其郊野，玛哈念与其郊野，

verses.en: Heshbon and its pasturelands, and Jazer and its pasturelands.

"Bible Interpretation Seminar")

FOLLOWING THE ORIGINAL AUTHOR'S INTENT AT THE PARAGRAPH LEVEL

This is a study guide commentary, which means that you are responsible for your own
interpretation of the Bible. Each of us must walk in the light we have. You, the Bible, and the Holy Spirit are priority in interpretation.
You must not relinquish this to a commentator.

Read the chapter in one sitting. Identify the subjects. Compare your subject divisions with the five translations
above. Paragraphing is not inspired, but it is the key to following the original author's intent, which is the heart of interpretation.
Every paragraph has one and only one subject.

- First paragraph

- Second paragraph

- Etc.

CONTEXTUAL INSIGHTS

- The MT has 41 verses in 1 Chronicles 5. English translations break the chapter division at 5:26.
The MT has 66 verses in 1 Chronicles 6. English translations have chapter 6 starting at 1 Chr. 5:27-6:81.

- This English division highlights the lineage of Levi. Israel's future is connected to

- the Davidic covenant (Judah)

- the Mosaic covenant (Levi)

- Basic outline:

- Notice how 1 Chr. 6:1-15 lists the line from Levi through Aaron, the first High Priest, to
Seraiah, the last High Priest in Jerusalem at the Babylonian exile of 586 B.C.

- 1 Chronicles 6:16-30 contains the specific families of the tribe of Levi.

- 1 Chronicles 6:31-48 deals with the families of Levitical musicians and singers.

- 1 Chronicles 6:49-53 deals with the tabernacle/temple duties of the High Priest.

- 1 Chronicles 6:54-81 details the cities and adjacent small farm land of the tribe of Levi.
They did not have any land allocation, just special cities (cf. Joshua 20-21).

- Why do the names in the lists of ancestors disagree?

- They are different persons by the same name. Often names recur in families and periods.

- There are two separate genealogies combined by an editor.

- The person went by two names.

- The person's name was changed.

- The term "son" can refer to a wide number of relatives.

- The first father died and the wife remarried or there was Levirate marriage involved.

- Ancient Jewish genealogies are often incomplete.
